title: Line Integral Tunneling
description: config.ini [Line Integral Tunneling] section (LineIntegralTunnelingConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

mep_filename.description: Multi-frame minimum-energy path crossing the saddle.

images.description: Images on each optimal tunnelling path.

replicas.description: Equally spaced imaginary-time replicas for HQTST.

energy_offset.description: First path energy below the saddle, in eV.

lowest_temperature.description: Lowest requested continuation temperature, in K.

energy_step.description: Maximum energy decrease between continuation paths, in eV.

log_rate_tolerance.description: Largest allowed change in ln(k) between continuation paths.

spring.description: LI-NEB spacing spring constant, in inverse Angstrom squared.

contour.description: Endpoint energy-contour parameter, in inverse eV Angstrom.

force_tolerance.description: Largest interior perpendicular or endpoint force.

period_tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance for the imaginary-time period quadrature, in the internal mass-weighted time unit.

determinant_estimated_error.description: Stopping target for the estimated ln k error from the stochastic ring and reactant log-determinants; not a certified error bound.

optimizer.description: LI-NEB optimizer; velocity_verlet is the paper default.
